class.name: BSControllerCommonOptions
class.description: Common configuration options for all BeamSpotISController applications.

attribute.name: Partition
attribute.description: Partition name for IS server with LB information, if empty use current partition.

attribute.name: LBServer
attribute.description: Name for IS server with LB information

attribute.name: LBObject
attribute.description: Name for IS object with LB information

attribute.name: ISServer
attribute.description: Name of a IS server with histogram data

attribute.name: ISProvider
attribute.description: Name of a IS provider for histogram data

attribute.name: BSTOptions
attribute.description: Additional options to pass to BST, space-separated string

attribute.name: TriggerChain
attribute.description: Trigger chain to use for intput histograms

attribute.name: CallbackPrescale
attribute.description: Frequency in LumiBlocks of calling beamSpotTool, default is every LB.

attribute.name: MinLBN
attribute.description: Minimum luminosity block to calculate beamspot parameters over. Can be negative for counting backward from current LBN.

attribute.name: MaxLBN
attribute.description: Maximum luminosity block to calculate beamspot parameters over. Can be negative for counting backward from current LBN.

attribute.name: RepInput
attribute.description: Specifies input representation, zero or more comma-separated keywords (csv, ismon, etc.)

attribute.name: RepOutput
attribute.description: Specifies output representation, zero or more comma-separated keywords (csv, onmon, etc.)

attribute.name: LogLevel
attribute.description: Application logging level, number from 1 to 5

attribute.name: BSTOptions
attribute.description: Additional options to pass to BST, space-separated string

relationship.name: CommonOptions
relationship.description: Reference to options which are usually common to all controllers.
